english: In a continuous frequency distribution, the class $[10(k-1),10k)$ has frequency $k^2(7-k)$ for $k=1,2,3,4,5,6$, and there are no other classes. Then the mode of this distribution is
hindi: एक सतत बारंबारता बंटन में $k=1,2,3,4,5,6$ के लिए वर्ग $[10(k-1),10k)$ की बारंबारता $k^2(7-k)$ है, तथा अन्य कोई वर्ग नहीं है। तब इस बंटन का बहुलक है
solution_full: The mode is close to $40$ because the neighbouring class on the left has almost the same frequency.
originality_note: New: frequencies given by the cubic rule k^2(7-k), whose maximum over integers sits next to an almost equal neighbour, so the modal class must be found by evaluation, not by calculus intuition (way 2: distribution defined by a rule). Closest known: grouped-mode exercises with a printed table. Different because: the table must be generated and the near tie decides the class.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, the class-boundary convention is explicit where it matters, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Changed: No change.
key_step: Generating the frequencies, picking the modal class despite the near tie, applying the formula.
justification: Routine multi-step use of one formula with a near-tie trap. Comparable to 2025-P1-Q14 (L2).
